scope.pending_policy: No active checkpoint read; fill actual tensor counts/replay/bytes/wall/peak from completed SHA-bound metadata later. No extra experiments requested.

server_cpu_shape_count_json.scope: Only ten terminal, SHA-bound server-local completed checkpoint CPU loads. Native pretrained=False architecture registry only; no forward, accuracy, training or CUDA. Model payloads never exported.

definitions.parameter_count: Native timm parameter-name registry matched exact completed checkpoint names/shapes. Counts use tensor.numel and actual dtype; buffers counted separately. No byte-to-parameter inference.
definitions.gradient_eligible: Parameters selected by native optimizer families. Frozen D/analytic learning is counted separately, not called zero learning. Reader CE work is shared with fixed ER.
definitions.active_inference_backbones: Networks whose forward participates in the configured final head. HT/PSB use one plastic body at inference and two bodies during training; current full head uses anchor plus plastic body.
definitions.training_frozen_anchor_parameter_bytes: Extra fixed reference branch, excluded from deployed HT/PSB inference. Current reference branch remains active at inference. Shared one frozen body is its deployment body, not an extra anchor.
definitions.shared_numeric_state_bytes: SharedPredictorBasis.resource_bytes sums G,C,feature_sum,counts,D and derived weights/intercept. Derived posterior is reconstructed on restore and absent from serialized predictor state.
definitions.history_statistics_bytes: TransportHistory.resource_bytes includes anchor_G,anchor_C,current_G,current_C,counts,head,last_transport. Reported deployment_analytic_head_bytes is already included: do not add it again.
definitions.plastic_statistics_bytes: Transport bytes plus SharedPredictorBasis resident bytes. Includes auxiliary transport ridge head and basis state. Deployment analytic head is a representation of basis weights/intercept already charged in basis bytes; no extra summation.
definitions.current_numeric_payload_bytes: CurrentMethod.resource_bytes dictionary: encoder_weights (anchor/main/libraries), statistics (G,C), readouts (W0,V), resident_anchor_cache (memory_base), optimizer_state (both optimizer state_dicts). These are logical tensor bytes, not CUDA peak or serialized bytes.
definitions.replay_raw_payload_bytes: ReplayMemory.payload_bytes sums ndarray.nbytes OR width*height*3 for each external image path, then adds 16 bytes per record. CIF arrays are raw RGB; ImageNet-R path payload is RGB-decoded equivalent, not compressed JPEG bytes, path-string bytes, or measured resident decoded memory.
definitions.numeric_checkpoint_payload_bytes: runner numeric_bytes(model.checkpoint_core()): recursive tensor/ndarray logical payload. Excludes outer stages/RNG container, Python/object/RawRecord image contents and strings; does not deduplicate repeated references. Not checkpoint file size.
definitions.checkpoint_file_bytes: Actual complete serialized checkpoint.pt size bound to its SHA; includes serialization and native state/replay representation. This is the disk number, distinct from resident logical numeric bytes.
definitions.actual_run_wall_seconds: runner begins after model/data initialization and resume setup; includes training/evaluation, stage checkpoint/progress I/O, final core accounting and metrics-by-head construction before the wall field; excludes imports/setup, later CE report assembly and final results.json write. If resumed, it measures only this process remaining work even though stage records include inherited prefix.
definitions.stage_wall_seconds: Starts before incremental_train, ends after evaluation and after_task, before stage checkpoint write. Sum need not equal run wall.
definitions.shared_native_ce_seconds: Fixed ER native CE adaptation wall with device synchronization. Replayed by HT/PSB, not executed anew by readers; count once per dataset in actual campaign compute totals.
definitions.executor_wall_seconds: CE wrapper actual call wall including identity guards, serialization/load, state and RNG work; record mode includes native CE, replay mode does not.
definitions.gpu_peak_allocated_bytes: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated of this process after reset before model/data creation. Excludes CUDA context, reserved/unallocated pool, other processes and CPU state. Reader peak does not measure full independent HT/PSB training peak.
definitions.ce_cache_disk: Sealed execution/recovery files, counted once by dataset donor asset; separate from algorithm replay-image budget and resident auxiliary arrays.
definitions.rng_and_optimizer: Outer runner RNG plus method-local replay RNG are recovery state. ER/HT/PSB reset AdamW per stage and save stage boundaries; Joint saves completed fit. Current persists two AdamW states and progress; dynamic phase requires_grad is not eligibility.

aggregation_rules: Sum actual per-job runner wall once; no shared CE double charge.
Never sum deployment analytic head on top of historical_statistics_bytes.
Do not compare reader-only peak VRAM to standalone native training peak.
Keep gradient parameters, learned/statistical numeric state, replay budget, external references, checkpoint file disk size and CE cache disk as separate columns.
Unmeasured external JPEG/path/Python memory stays null; do not silently substitute decoded equivalent.
Only current full-head has two active inference backbones; final requires_grad flags do not determine its optimizer eligibility.
